identity.standaloneProfile: Signed-permit client bootstrap is bound to appId=differentiator; browser-controlled state is not sufficient authority for a future protected school-server operation.
identity.schoolProfile: Server-session enforcement is prepared in the school deployment profile and remains deferred until an approved school runtime is connected.
identity.rule: Role, ownership and session claims originating only from client storage never authorize a future protected server-side action.

requestApiAi.controls: GHRAB AI Core operation registry, fixed teacher-selected model profiles, bounded request and output contracts, no provider tools, no autonomous tool loop and no model-triggered application side effects.

egress.standalone: The current GitHub Pages profile permits explicit direct-gemini transport with a session-scoped teacher key and no automatic fallback.
egress.school: The school profile permits only school-gateway transport, forbids local provider keys and requires LIVE validation when that profile is connected.
egress.crossApp: Cross-application interaction is limited to platform access, lifecycle, handoff, manifest and verified release-notification contracts.

files.currentBoundary: Teacher-controlled text, office documents, PDFs, scans, images, GeoJSON and multimedia are untrusted inputs and pass existing size, type, parsing, sanitization and bounded-processing controls before application or AI use.
files.serverBoundary: Server-side quarantine and server document processing are not claimed in the current release and remain deferred with the school-server phase.

dataLifecycle.classification: D2 educational content may include student-related material; pseudonymisation is not treated as anonymisation and real sensitive student data must not be used to claim LIVE approval.
dataLifecycle.storage: Namespaced localStorage and sessionStorage plus PWA CacheStorage are inventoried in src/config/data-manifest.json and covered by suite-session cleanup.
dataLifecycle.retention: Current standalone retention follows the data manifest and explicit end-work/browser controls; future server retention is not active.
dataLifecycle.deletion: Client cleanup removes working data, credential remnants and target-scoped handoff state while preserving documented non-content preferences and security tombstones.

release.promotion: candidate -> P5 plus GARP 2.5.1 regressions and GARP 2.7 gates -> protected candidate-to-main pull request -> exact release identity -> verified Pages deployment -> app-updated notification
release.publicAssurance: GitHub Pages remains the current standalone deployment; school-server SHIELD-LIVE and RI-LIVE are not claimed.
release.rollback: Existing release-integrity binding, Safe Promotion ancestry checks and prior verified releases remain the rollback baseline.

inventory.changeRule: Any new AI operation, provider tool, egress mode, import class, privileged browser capability, storage authority or release authority requires inventory and matching test updates before admission.

securityHealth.localCi: GARP 2.7 contract, semantic policy admission, architecture-integrity, mutation and auto-patch gates run together with retained GARP 2.5.1 and P5 controls.
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED for school runtime until approved infrastructure supplies trusted runtime evidence.
securityHealth.failureMode: Harness errors, empty scope, stale or mismatched evidence, missing controls and trust-anchor drift never become PASS.

incident.current: Bounded error reporting, fail-closed access behavior, release evidence and Safe Promotion remain active; diagnostic content is minimized by existing policy.
incident.future: Central watchdog, server monitoring and infrastructure containment remain deferred until the school runtime is approved.

recovery.current: Safe Promotion, exact release identity, deterministic lockfile build inputs, prior release history, client cleanup and release-integrity tooling remain the recovery baseline.
recovery.future: Server restore, trust-root custody and live recovery drills remain NOT_TESTED until the school runtime is approved.
